title: Single violation: PDT block on a same-day round trip
notes: Margin account, equity $19,000 (< $25,000 PDT equity threshold), pattern_day_trader=false, daytrade_count=3 already used in the rolling 5-business-day window. The 50-share AAPL position was opened_at 2026-08-27T09:31:00Z, the same calendar day as as_of (2026-08-27T14:30:00Z) -- selling it now closes a position opened today, which is by definition day trade #4. 4 day trades in 5 business days on an account under $25k equity trips Reg T's pattern-day-trader restriction, so R2_PDT is BLOCKING and no repair can fix it (the only fix is not selling today, which contradicts the instruction). Decision is BLOCK; zero orders reach the broker.
